WITH event_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) as avg_analyst_count,
    AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) as avg_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
gap_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_gap) as overall_avg_gap
  FROM event_gaps
)
SELECT 
  eg.corpeventprx,
  eg.avg_analyst_count,
  eg.avg_gap,
  eg.avg_gap - gs.overall_avg_gap as gap_minus_overall_avg
FROM event_gaps eg
CROSS JOIN gap_stats gs
WHERE gs.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL
